full_judgment: 13. On perusal of the impugned judgment and decree of the last court of fact and on examination of both oral and documentary evidences on record and the attending facts and circumstances I find the appellate court has committed serious illegality in not considering the finding of the trial court regarding adverse possession of the plaintiff in the suit tank in respect of 8 annas share of Kamini Mohan and Ashwini Mohan Sen and failing to notice the averment relating to claim of adverse possession and title at paragraph 3 of the plaint illegally found in his impugned judgment that the plaintiffs did not claim adverse title and thus illegally and arbitrarily allowed the appeal in part and dismissed the suit in respect of aforesaid share measuring 59 decimals of the suit tank the said finding of the last court of fact is erroneous and not at all sustainable in the facts and circumstances of the instant case and on this point the very reversal of the last court of fact is not proper and not in accordance with law and the same is based on serious illegality material irregularity as well as the very finding of the learned appellate Judge is perverse finding which has resulted in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. On that ground the very finding of the learned Appellate court is not tenable in law. I also find at the trial 6 P.Ws were examined and in view of the clear admission of D.Ws 2 and 3 who stated that Sekendar Ali “সেকান্দার আলী নালিশা ভূমি বন্দোবস্ত নিয়া.............. তবে ১৯৯২ ইং সনে খরিদের পর বাদীগণ (নালিশা পুকুর) দখল করে।”
